extracted_factors.Label: Rising Eldercare Costs
extracted_factors.Description: The cost of caregiving in Hong Kong is projected to rise significantly, influencing the development of preventive measures and insurance products.

extracted_factors.Label: Prevalence of Dementia
extracted_factors.Description: Increasing rates of dementia among the elderly is a driver for healthcare interventions and awareness campaigns.

extracted_factors.Label: Awareness of Dementia and Preventive Measures
extracted_factors.Description: Efforts to raise awareness around dementia and encourage preventive measures are resulting from partnerships and public-private collaborations.

extracted_factors.Label: Collaboration with NGOs and Private Sector
extracted_factors.Description: Public-private partnerships aim to provide more resources and access to healthcare for the elderly, targeting dementia and eldercare.

extracted_pain_points.description: Limited access to primary healthcare services and dementia screening for the elderly population.
The financial burden of caregiving and dementia management on families and society.
Challenges in early detection and management of dementia risks.
